mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises simultaneously, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, if the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 1 month during a tightening cycle and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
